Used to identify a client.
Useful for publishers that
wish to identify the source of
a publish, client status
messages and for client
heartbeats.
Can be set with logon
command.

One of:
publish
subscribe
sow
sow_and_subscribe
sow_delete
unsubscribe
flush
heartbeat
logon

Client-specified command ID.
The CmdId is returned by the
engine in responses to
commands to allow the
client to correlate the
response to the command.

Opaque token set by an
application and returned
with the message.

If true, only send raw data
to subscriber for a matching
publish message, i.e. do not
include FIX/NVFIX envelope.

SOW expiration time if used
in publish.
